explanation.headline: Labetalol hydrochloride supply traces to a plant with multiple VAI inspections; not on FDA shortage list today

sentences.text: The product label identifies Heritage Pharma Labs Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Labs Inc. (FEI 3005139373) as the manufacturing plant for labetalol hydrochloride NDC 23155072305.
FDA records show that plant received Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classifications after inspections ending 2009-07-14, 2013-11-21, 2014-01-08, 2015-04-16, 2017-04-20, and 2018-02-06.
The most recent inspection on file ended 2018-02-06 with a VAI classification.
Corvale East has 301 units on hand at 11.4 units per day (26 days supply) and Corvale General has 297 units at 13.8 units per day (22 days supply).

rejected.text: The drug is not listed on FDA's shortage list as of today.
The recommended buy option is A-S Medication Solutions, though its label names no plant we could place.
Verify current availability with A-S Medication Solutions and monitor FDA shortage listings for any future posting.

Q-b53eef.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%labetalol%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%labetalol%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-18f169.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('bf84ebae-3c91-4448-b1db-8e5ed3053866') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-8d78c6.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%labetalol%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-3e8737.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%labetalol%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-05d3f2.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%labetalol%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-504675.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3005139373') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-bcd8f5.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3005139373') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-f50d20.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3005139373') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('heritage d b a avet')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-7cb388.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('heritage d b a avet') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%labetalol%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-888dd6.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('23155072305')

Q-afeefe.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%labetalol%'
